Hasmukh yells at Aryan for following the instructions of an empath. The principal calls Hasmukh asd asks him to shift to another town. Hasmukh’s family rejects the idea and request him to not walk out of the house for next three days.
If you are trying to view this video from a location outside India, do note this video will be made available in your territory 48 hours after its upload time
